summary.note: Aggressor tagging reflects print location versus quote only. It does not identify opening versus closing trades or directional intent.

/api/options/SPY/flow.note: Call does not mean bullish and put does not mean bearish. Aggressor tagging describes where the print landed in the quote, nothing more.

/api/history/SPY/gex.note: History accumulates while the app runs; each dashboard refresh records one point. An empty series simply means nothing has been captured yet.
